Useful memory has boundaries
A successor inherits tools, not authority.
Inspect the exact retained asset and the conditions for using it again. Historical evidence remains historical when the task or dependency changes.
WORLD
The task changed.
Source clauses, prerequisite graph, weights and output limit define each fresh requirement.
POLICY
The rules stay fixed.
Budgets, qualification criteria, retention rules and stopping conditions are fixed before evaluation.
PROOF
Check the current case.
A stored successful receipt does not establish current correctness. Re-evaluate against the current input.
AUTHORITY
Permission is separate.
Pure local research only. No wallet, settlement, production grants or current proof travel with the artifact.
Permitted to carry forward
  • An exact, inspectable executable recipe
  • Its source identity and provenance
  • Historical outcomes, failures and full costs
  • Validity limits and retirement conditions
Requires a fresh decision
  • Fitness for the next requirement
  • Compatibility with changed dependencies
  • Available budget and unexpired scope
  • Any production or financial authority
